plain: A possible event that must be planned for.

webster.text: The quality of being contingent or casual; a happening; or the possibility of coming to pass.

example.quote: It has been the case in many countries, and no government can exist unless its powers extend to make provisions for every contingency.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 6, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
